finding.pattern:
TanStack AI supports streaming chat with SSE format: - chat() function with adapter, messages, stream options - Tool calling with toolDefinition and server implementations - SSE events: 'content', 'tool_call', 'tool_result', 'done' - Structured output with outputSchema (Zod)
RAG Integration Pattern: - Use tools to inject retrieval results into chat - Stream responses while maintaining citation links - Tool calls trigger retrieval before response generation

finding.query: RAG prompt engineering 2024 context window management
finding.pattern:
Context Engineering Best Practices (2024): - Prioritize relevant information at beginning or end of context window - Performance degrades when relevant info is in middle of long contexts - Dynamic context retrieval preferred over static full-history - Structured context enhances model performance - Entity extraction from conversations for key information
Context Window Management: - Memory hierarchies and compression techniques - Self-refinement mechanisms - Conversation summarization for multi-turn chats - Explicit instruction passing for user preferences

Current chat implementation (Story 7-3): - /api/chat endpoint with TanStack AI - SSE streaming with openaiText adapter - Tool calling via agent tools (FileTools, TerminalTools)
Need to extend for Story 7-5: - RAG-specific tool for retrieval - Citation formatting in responses - Source panel UI component - Conversation memory with citations

architecture_patterns.pattern:
ExtendedSearchResult has source and rank fields: - source: 'bm25' | 'vector' | 'rrf' - rank: position in results (0-indexed) - highlightedText: preview with matched terms
Format citations as [1], [2], [3] based on rank

Extend RAGStore with chat state: - chatMessages: ChatMessage[] (with citations) - citations: Map - activeCitation: Citation | null (for source panel) - sendRAGMessage(query) action (orchestrates retrieval + generation) - showCitation(citation) action - closeCitationPanel() action

SSE stream events for RAG chat: - 'content': response text chunks - 'tool_call': retrieval invocation - 'tool_result': retrieved chunks - 'done': completion
Citations appear inline as [source_id] references

technical_notes.note: TanStack AI uses tool calling for RAG injection. Define ragTool that calls hybridRetriever.search() and returns chunks.
Context window management is critical. Use limit: 10 in RetrievalOptions to prevent overwhelming the prompt.
Citation numbering should be 1-indexed for user display ([1], not [0]).
Conversation memory should persist citations across turns. Store Citation objects in Map for efficient lookup.
Source panel should use slide-over animation (CSS transform). Highlighted text should reuse SearchHighlighter from Story 7-4.
Consider context summarization for long conversations (> 10 turns). Research indicates performance degradation with middle-context info.
